title: Ravencrest Monument
wikitext:
[[image:raven-monu.jpg|thumb|Ravencrest Monument]]

'''Ravencrest Monument''' is a huge statue in [[Azshara]], raised in honor of Lord [[Kur'talos Ravencrest]]. He led the resistance after the fall of [[Zin-Azshari]], [[Suramar]], and countless other cities against the [[Burning Legion]], and fought beside the young [[Tyrande]] and the brothers [[Illidan]] and [[Malfurion Stormrage]]. 

Sadly, the statue now lies in ruins; only the broken-off legs still stand and various parts are visible on the ground around them. Presumably, the rest has sunk beneath the waves of the [[Great Sea]]. The ruins are inhabited by a tribe of [[naga]], as always {{reputation|hostile}} against intruders.

Do '''''not''''' try to access Ravencrest Monument by sea, you must go across land and cross a bridge. {{coords|65|87|Azshara}}

== Trivia ==

The statue of Ravencrest is similiar to that of one mentioned in the poem "{{Wplink|Ozymandias}}" by Percy Bysshe Shelley. The poem is very similar to the original history of the night elves.
